tldr: Canadian competitors are moving on new asset classes and acquisition offers: CIBC keeps expanding its CDR lineup (now 145, including a U.S. Anthropic IPO-linked receipt) and Wealthsimple is beta-testing a CAD stablecoin and a 3.25% promotional CADD. Meanwhile BMO and Scotiabank are running big chequing cash bonuses, and OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet and Kalshi's night and weekend stock perps point to new expectations around agentic payments and off-hours trading.
themes: Access to U.S. and hot-IPO stocks for Canadians (CDRs)

highlights.headline: CIBC adds a CDR tied to the Anthropic U.S. IPO and takes its CDR lineup to 145, with another U.S. CDR announced a day earlier
highlights.why: CIBC is turning CDRs into a fast channel for Canadians to get hot U.S. names in CAD without FX friction. Simplii, as a CIBC brand, should check whether its self-directed investing clients get these, and how that experience compares with Wealthsimple.

highlights.headline: Wealthsimple opens retail betas for Tetra's CAD stablecoin and a CADD offering with 3.25% promotional rewards
highlights.why: The closest direct rival is testing CAD-denominated digital money and a promo-rate hook at once. Simplii should decide whether it needs a response on CAD stablecoin access or a rate/rewards counter.

highlights.headline: BMO Performance Chequing offers up to $1,100 cash plus Walmart+ for up to 12 months, while Scotiabank offers up to $1,000 for moving pay and $175 for students
highlights.why: Big-bank switch bonuses at this level, tied to direct deposit, raise the bar for Simplii's own acquisition offers. Walmart+ bundling also shows partner perks are being used as a differentiator.

highlights.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, letting AI agents pay on users' behalf without seeing card details; Kalshi's U.S.-regulated stock perps traded $1.75B in week one, with ~39% of volume outside regular hours
highlights.why: These show two expectation shifts: AI agents initiating payments, and trading outside the 9:30–4:00 session. Simplii's cards and trading roadmap should consider both: agent-ready tokenized payments and extended-hours trading.
